data.one_liner: Parse and write SDP strings in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to parse Session Description Protocol (SDP) text into JSON-like maps and to serialize those structures back to SDP. Includes helpers for parsing specific SDP attributes like payloads and simulcast.
use_when: You need to handle WebRTC signaling data in a Flutter app.
You require a pure‑Dart SDP parser/writer without native dependencies.
avoid_when: You only need high‑level WebRTC APIs that abstract SDP handling.
You need a full‑featured media negotiation library rather than just parsing.
strengths: Zero dependencies and pure Dart implementation.
Supports RFC‑compliant parsing and writing, including recent grammar updates.
weaknesses: Limited to SDP parsing/writing; no higher‑level WebRTC utilities.
No built‑in validation beyond basic parsing.
